Fankai Dai

he/him/his
PhD Student
The University of Hong Kong
Contact fankaidai@connect.hku.hk





My name is Fankai Dai. I am currently a Ph.D. student in the School of Future Media at the University of Hong Kong, supervised by Prof. King-wa Fu and Prof. Bin Chen.
My research interests include digital journalism, political communication, and platform governance.
Previously, I received a B.A. from Zhejiang University and an M.A. from Tsinghua University. I also worked as a journalism intern at Caixin Media and The Paper.





In Chinese

Li, H., Liu, Y., Dai, F. (2026). Where’s the Covid-19 testing stations now? Liminal Memoryscape, and Covid-19 Heritage in China’s Urban Space. Communication & Society (TSSCI), 75, 1–36. [Publisher’s Version]
Zhou, R., Wang, W., Dai, F., & Zhou, Z. (2021). Learning to make news: How Chinese college students and faculty covered the Covid-19 pandemic. Shanghai Journalism Review (CSSCI), 11, 53–65.
